1. The above audited financial results of the ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited (the Company) for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors at its Meeting held on October 14, 2025.

2. The above audited financial results were audited by the joint statutory auditors, Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, Chartered Accountants and PKF Sridhar & Santhanam LLP, Chartered Accountants who have issued an unmodified opinion on these financial results.

3. During the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025, the Company has allotted 829,451 equity shares and 1,739,142 equity shares respectively of face value of Rs. 10 each pursuant to exercise of employee stock options and employee stock units granted. (For the quarter and year to date ended September 30, 2024, 1,470,220 equity shares and 2,006,928 equity shares respectively allotted and for the year ended March 31, 2025, 3,041,182 equity shares allotted of face value of Rs. 10 each).

4. The Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of Rs. 6.50 per equity share of face value of Rs. 10 each at its meeting held on October 14, 2025.

5. In accordance with the IRDAI (Actuarial, Finance and Investment Functions of Insurers) Regulation, 2024 and Master Circular thereon dated May 17, 2024, with effect from October 1, 2024, the Company has given effect to recognise gross written premium on a 1/n basis where "n" denotes the policy duration and commissions paid only on such recorded gross written premium for applicable long term products. This has resulted in a decrease in Gross Premium Written by Rs. 36,078 lakhs & Rs. 68,052 lakhs respectively for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025, also resulted in decrease of commissions & brokerage (net) and consequently, operating profit/(loss) by Rs. 1,433 lakhs & Rs. 3,171 lakhs respectively for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025. This resulted in the increase in Profit / (Loss) after tax by Rs. 1,092 lakhs & Rs. 2,399 lakhs respectively for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025. Had the Company not considered the 1/n effect, the combined ratio would have been 103.9% & 103.0% respectively for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 and 102.6% for the year ended 31st March 2025.
6. Figures of the previous period have been re-grouped wherever necessary, to conform to the current year presentation.
7. In view of the seasonality of Industry, the financial results for the quarters are not indicative of full year's expected performance.
8. The amounts for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 are balancing amounts between the amounts as per audited accounts for the half year ended September 30, 2025 and for the quarter ended June 30, 2025.
9. In accordance with requirements of IRDAI circular no. IRDAI/F&A/CIR/MISC/256/09/2021 dated September 30, 2021 on Public Disclosures by Insurers, the Company will publish the financials on the company's website latest by October 29, 2025.
